text:
ops-bot: @here Soft-GA announcement: we are opening a controlled soft-GA for NVIDIA Blackwell B520 (b520) Dedicated pools in eu-central-fra (Frankfurt), af-south-jnb (Johannesburg), and ap-south-mum (Mumbai). This is a limited GA with constrained quotas and a phased rollout.
eli_pm: Quick context: soft-GA means we will enforce SLAs for participating tenants but maintain capacity controls and a conservative burst policy. This lets us validate operating scale before full public GA. Signup for GA-express access: https://redwood.example.com/b520-softga. Include expected sustained throughput and 99th pct latency targets.
sanjay_infra: Deployment details: pool names b520-fra-ga, b520-jnb-ga, b520-mum-ga. Initial capacity: Frankfurt 24 GPUs (6 nodes), Johannesburg 8 GPUs (2 nodes), Mumbai 12 GPUs (3 nodes). Preemptible mode: enabled in FRA and MUM, disabled in JNB. HSM/KMS: FRA and JNB have HSM enabled; MUM HSM scheduled within 48h. Default session cap: 48h for GA tenants, 12h for trial tenants.
marina_prod: Product notes: GA customers will see a new "instance class" in Console labelled B520.dedicated. Console will show per-route token-cost deltas and an estimated p50/p95 baseline for 4k and 32k contexts. Please do not call this "general availability" outside GA cohort.
carlos_sre: Monitoring & reliability: enabled per-node power-thermal autoscaling and an adaptive ECC retry policy. New pager thresholds for GA: temp>=86C, mem errs>4/min. Added a regional topology card and a per-tenant quota view. We recorded one pilot incident (thermal throttling on continuous 32k runs)  mitigated by auto-throttle and graceful eviction.
ben_security: Security & compliance: FRA and JNB nodes meet our internal KMS/HSM requirements for regulated workloads; MUM is not yet compliant. All GA pools will have full audit logs and extended retention (configurable per contract). Reminder: tenants must request compliance onboarding for regulated data.
anya_sales: GTM guidance: weve cleared a small set of pilot customers for soft-GA (ProtoTech, DataMuse, EdgeSense). Sales: do not promise broad availability or unlimited capacity. For pipeline customers who need priority, route requests to me with workload and SLA needs.
kate_legal: Contracting note: soft-GA customers will be asked to sign a limited addendum that clarifies the phased nature of rollout and outlines incident handling and credits. Legal will auto-send to anyone who opts into the GA form.
sanjay_infra: Operational limits & quotas: per-tenant max GPUs during soft-GA = min(8 GPUs, 25% of region). We also enabled per-tenant isolation policies to avoid noisy neighbor effects. CLI example to reserve GA capacity (for approved tenants):
```
redwood reserve --pool b520-fra-ga --count 2 --duration 24h --tenant=datamuse --note "b520 soft-ga smoke"
```
marina_prod: Perf summary (internal CI): FRA 4k context p50 65ms/token p95 180ms/token; 32k context p50 210ms/token p95 620ms/token. MUM 4k p50 70ms/token p95 200ms/token. JNB numbers more variable due to network egress. Perf doc & spreadsheet: will be posted to #eng-runtime and Console links by EOD.
carlos_sre: Incidents and mitigations: one JNB node had a sustained PSU fault during pilot -> drained + replaced under 4h. Added PSU health checks to nightly telemetry. Also added a firmware holdback flag for any node that sees >2 ECC events in 24h.
ben_security: Action: security to deliver an onboarding checklist for tenants (HSM key enrollment, access review, approved data types) in 3 business days.
eli_pm: Roadmap & gating: we will expand soft-GA cohort after 2 weeks if 1) ECC/thermal incidents <3 in rolling week, 2) perf regressions <4% vs baseline, and 3) compliance onboarding is automated for the region. Full public GA to follow after successful cohort expansion.
anya_sales: Action: GTM to compile additional customer candidates for cohort by Tue COB.
kate_legal: Action: Legal to prepare the soft-GA addendum template and automated signature flow (ETA 5 business days).
sanjay_infra: Action: infra to enable MUM HSM (ETA 48h), add per-tenant quota enforcement, and publish infra-admin override API docs (ETA 72h).
marina_prod: Action: product to publish B520 perf guidance, tuning hints, and SLO expectations in Console (ETA 48h).
carlos_sre: Action: SRE to add PSU checks, firmware holdback playbook, and update runbooks (ETA 72h).
ops-bot: :rocket: Epic created: b520-soft-ga-rollout. If you see anything off, open a ticket with tag [b520-soft-ga] and ping the owners. Thanks team!
